findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agent_room_create_room, agent_room_get_messages, agent_room_list_rooms, agent_room_room_access, agent_room_room_messages, agent_room_wait_for_messages · Private data: agent_room_create_room, agent_room_enter_room, agent_room_join, agent_room_leave, agent_room_list_rooms, agent_room_send_message, agent_room_wait_for_messages · Public sink: agent_room_create_room, agent_room_invite_person, agent_room_room_access, agent_room_send_message · Destructive: agent_room_get_messages, agent_room_remove_agent, agent_room_room_messages, agent_room_wait_for_messages.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agent_room_create_room, agent_room_get_messages, agent_room_list_rooms, agent_room_room_access, agent_room_room_messages, agent_room_wait_for_messages · Private data: agent_room_create_room, agent_room_enter_room, agent_room_join, agent_room_leave, agent_room_list_rooms, agent_room_send_message, agent_room_wait_for_messages · Public sink: agent_room_create_room, agent_room_invite_person, agent_room_room_access, agent_room_send_message · Destructive: agent_room_get_messages, agent_room_remove_agent, agent_room_room_messages, agent_room_wait_for_messages

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
